items.content_html:
This PR introduces an variety of changes to the smartd module:

  • Shellcheck validation of the notification script
  • Dynamic detection of the X11 session to send notifications to.
  • Systemd unit hardening
  • NixOS tests for all notification mechanisms + various device detection
  • Remove dbus package as an optional dep, replace with busctl from systemd

The changes should be backwards compatible with the exception of sendmail implementations that requires further relaxed hardening (if there are any).

Ref #377827

items.content_html:
The symlink at /nixos-closure that is used by
initrd-nixos-activation is created by
initrd-find-nixos-closure, but there is no relationship declared between the two services. In some environments, I've encountered issues where systemd schedules initrd-nixos-activation before initrd-find-nixos-closure, resulting in a nixos system that never leaves the initrd. This change ensures that initrd-nixos-activation only runs after /nixos-closure is populated.

We're about to introduce a third variant with the same copy-and-paste approach, so this is the right moment to unify.

This commit moves the nixos-rebuild-specialisations and nixos-rebuild-store-path tests into nixos/tests/nixos-rebuild/, extracting their identical machine definition and configuration.nix boilerplate into a common.nix module with a mkConfigFile helper.

I also moved nixos-rebuild-target-host there for co-location; since it's a two-node deploy test, it keeps its own scaffolding instead of importing common.nix, but it's all nice and tidy in the nixos/tests/nixos-rebuild/ directory.

Behavior of these tests does not change.
